name: ohmyink-stencil-processing

sourcePolicy.selection: Every request is generated by AI. The AI source decision (concept, mapped art style, blackwork base, filters, colorMode, fillEnclosedRegions) is persisted before enqueueing and queues one 2x2 contact-sheet generation.
sourcePolicy.oldRows: Old catalog or unrecognised rows are never generated; they fail safely if they are ever run.
sourcePolicy.idempotency: A verified clientId/requestId/capabilityToken returns the persisted job before source selection or provider work.

instantDrawProfile.conceptPolicy: Reject mandala or mandalas and the Chinese forms 曼陀羅, 曼陀罗, 曼荼羅, and 曼荼罗.
instantDrawProfile.artDirection: One small recognizable motif with approximately 6–12 clean strokes as guidance, minimal interior detail, open whitespace, and no dense effects. AI originals are simple black outlines even for Cyber & ornamental.

queue.idempotency: clientId + requestId; client pre-persists a secure 256-bit capabilityToken for response-loss recovery

pipeline: validate input against the instant-draw profile, including noMandala; the frontend submits its blank-state Surprise me value as a normal request
persist a V1 AI decision (concept, mapped art style, blackwork base, filters, colorMode, fillEnclosedRegions) before enqueueing
call ImageService once for a 2x2 outline contact sheet and persist four separately split originals
for color rows use the referenced full-design color helper with fillEnclosedRegions true; monochrome remains deterministic and original mode does not edit
derive mirrored artist PNG/SVG only from each uncolored normal-orientation original

recovery.startup: before accepting HTTP requests, mark all prior generating/processing jobs failed and re-enqueue queued jobs
recovery.interruptedPost: resubmit the same clientId/requestId and pre-saved capabilityToken; verified ownership returns the existing persisted source decision without another provider run
recovery.colorVersionFailure: mark the job failed with a safe color-specific English message; no automatic paid retry or unchanged-image fallback
recovery.aiFailure: mark the AI job failed with a safe English message; never never automatically retry paid work

limitation: This API-process queue is not a distributed durable worker system. Use one worker instance; completed artwork and metadata are durable. This JSON describes the workflow; actual tunable image-processing values come from runtimeOverrides environment variables.
